review_scope: Independent read-only static review; no actual future gate integration or model execution
checks: Terminal and exact declaration/summary references precede historical or new stage processing.
The unchanged previous finalizer verifies 10 historical attempts; only missing common-market C F0 can be replaced, with at most one new attempt and cumulative ceiling 11.

Late D0 semantic review is recorded separately, checked after prior terminal and before new protocol; original reports remain immutable.

Output is exclusive and rejected inside any historical or new raw run.

errors.reason: No blocking static defect found in terminal, history, scope, count, ACK or exclusive-output guards.

consistency.reason: The adapter/coordinator/finalizer agree on one C F0, 10 historical attempts, maximum 11, exact external D0 and typed runtime bindings.

paper_topic.reason: Five-condition exploratory endpoints and raw diagnostics remain intact; no new main experiment, performance claim, semantic success score or raw repair is introduced.
